broader_scalar_diagnostic.status: diagnostic test passed; residual performance cost located to a broader boundary
broader_scalar_diagnostic.kind: Single frozen GL21 base scalar test, excluded from physical performance and dispatch gates
broader_scalar_diagnostic.route_order_certificate: The existing test constructs fresh CLI graph states in localized-3D, erased-3D, projected-4D order; each generates no_numerator then numerator. Six cut-discovery starts and six completed graph-build scopes match this sequence. All events share the first CLI logfile because the process logger has one sink.
scope_notes: Three graph states share one test process; this is one diagnostic observation per route, not three cold repetitions.
The base numerator attaches Q1.Q2 times Q5.Q6 as graph-owned edge factors; it is distinct from the q7_squared probe.

supergraph_parametric_orchestration includes local and integrated UV construction plus final forest assembly, before numerical tensor/evaluator processing. It is not an isolated hard-projection timer.
The Boolean compile field in debug events is a semantic tag, not the evaluator compile setting. Existing scalar test settings explicitly disable generated-code compilation.
Preserved initial CLI states contain no final generated integrand binaries, so no new evaluator operation-count claim is made.

interpretation.measured: The no-numerator 4D orchestration is faster, while the graph-owned product numerator increases orchestration and subsequent tensor preprocessing. Numerical Symbolica construction is slightly lower than erased 3D. The hard projection and outer-selection intervals together are only 137.818 ms within the numerator’s 5944.078 ms orchestration.
interpretation.inference: Most residual cost lies after integrated-addback localization in final mapped-integrand assembly/simplification and forest aggregation. The existing FinalIntegrandBuilder tail replaces energies, simplifies metrics/color and expands dot products; HedgePoset aggregation then collects color, adds terms and replaces split momenta. Different factorized inputs reach these shared owners, so their cost can differ.
interpretation.limit: Interevent gaps do not isolate individual functions; this trace does not prove whether a specific replacement, color/metric traversal, dot-product rewrite or combination is the dominant operation. No production changes or new expectations were introduced.

scope: Six separate cold source911f GL00/GL01 profiles. Profile wall and stage times are excluded from all unprofiled generation/runtime performance gates.

full_local_uv_dispatch_gate.denominator_scope: Sum of complete nonroot legacy forest nodes: Taylor, child projection and final outer-CT assembly. Root production CFF, final forest summation and tensor/evaluator construction are excluded.
full_local_uv_dispatch_gate.outer_numerator_policy: Complete selection minus only the winner's native generation, source reconstruction and postprocessing. Every losing request, proposal construction/certificate, winner degree/capacity preparation and selection/drop cost is charged.

count_audit.scope: One cold, completely logged legacy forest uses one projection context. Until the full gate and counter checks pass these are observations, not completed-generation totals. Cumulative counters use the last snapshot, never their sum.

native_source_identity_certificate.proof: A complete cold context must generate each previously unseen CFF key at least once. Canonical ParsedGraph fields plus ordered bounds are a projection of the complete key (energy-edge maps and other options omitted). Distinct projected keys provide a lower bound; native generation calls provide an upper bound. Equal bounds certify exact full-key uniqueness even if retention is bypassed. Unequal bounds leave uniqueness null. Parsed-source identity retains labels, signatures, masses and boundaries; it is not graph isomorphism or unlabelled physical incidence.

count_audit.uniqueness_limit: Full structural keys and sample tuples are not logged. The explicit native-key bound certificate can sometimes establish CFF uniqueness; otherwise evictions, oversized bypasses and explicit row-wave clears allow repeated builds/misses. CFF lookup counters include both candidate count and selected payload lookups. Row lookups are per relevant subtree/sample subset, not per complete row. Build and request counts must not be relabeled unique sources or tuples.
count_audit.retention_limit: Evictions count LRU victims only; replacements, oversize bypasses and explicit clears are not evictions. Bytes are accounted retention at recorded endpoints, not RSS or true peak. Live entry counts appear in an existing summary event without #profile and are absent from the minimal filter.
count_audit.evaluator_size: Use the existing count_evaluators executable on the completed saved state for exact program instructions and operation counts. State-file bytes and Atom-stage bytes are separate sizes, not evaluator heap bytes.

GL00.phase_scope: Individual boundaries can be nested. In particular selection residual already includes losing native time; child dispatch already includes losing template preparation; cumulative cache snapshots are not summed. The full gate applies the nonoverlapping parser accounting.

memory_boundary_definitions.rss_bytes: Observed process resident set at the stage-event observation, not a synchronous in-process allocation measurement.
memory_boundary_definitions.vmhwm_bytes: Cumulative process resident high-water mark at this observation; not the maximum of this phase alone.
memory_boundary_definitions.event_lag_seconds: Observation timestamp minus structured event timestamp. Every requested event is retained; short stages may share an observed resident-set sample.
memory_boundary_definitions.literal_symbolica_build_entry: Every evaluator_symbolica_build_start, distinct from the earlier evaluator_expression_preparation_start.

timing_boundary_definitions.literal_symbolica_build_ms: Sum of the nonoverlapping evaluator_symbolica_build_done elapsed_ms intervals across all generated evaluators.
timing_boundary_definitions.native_symbolica_orchestration_ms: evaluator_stack_new_done.symbolica_ms includes expression/function-map preparation, actual builds and numeric program conversion; broader than literal .build.
timing_boundary_definitions.phase_medians: Profiles have one independent fresh process per graph/route; they are phase diagnostics, not repeated performance medians.

deferred_gl262_memory_evidence.kind: Read-only memory-boundary audit; no instrumentation, builds or workloads run

GL00_GL01.reason: Final receipts retain only global maxima. Neither completed direct profile has a stage RSS monitor; logged timing milestones contain no RSS/HWM values.
GL00_GL01.consequence: Do not relabel a whole-process peak as pre-evaluator RAM or infer a boundary value from total timing.

supported_boundaries.forest_compute_done: Completed UV construction; before later graph assembly and tensor preprocessing.
supported_boundaries.evaluator_stack_parse_atoms_start: Before tensor parsing/contraction of the evaluator inputs.
supported_boundaries.evaluator_stack_parse_atoms_done: After full Spenso preprocessing; before evaluator orchestration, not necessarily immediately before Symbolica .build.
supported_boundaries.evaluator_expression_preparation_start/d: Preparation immediately preceding individual expression evaluator construction.
supported_boundaries.evaluator_symbolica_build_start: Actual per-expression Symbolica .build entry, before the call; observed sample may lag.

limitations: Samples are observed after log events; current RSS is not an exact synchronous entry value or phase peak.
VmHWM remains cumulative for the process; subtracting two HWM values does not measure phase allocation.
Historical bootstrap events deliberately have no retrospective memory values.
No core instrumentation change is required; profiles must be monitored while live.
The two currently prepared direct dispatch profiles alone cannot establish an erased/localized pre-evaluator memory comparison.

deferred_gl262_memory_evidence.native_timer_semantics: GraphGenerationStats.expression_build_time subtracts both aggregate Spenso and Symbolica-stage timers plus compilation. evaluator_symbolica_time begins immediately after parsed_atoms and also contains later expression preparation and numeric program handling; actual .build has its own start/done stages.
